name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

body.body:
={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
  "max_tokens": 400,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says 'remote'.

REJECT if:
- Requires worker to live in US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan
- Requires local work authorization outside Taiwan
- Is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only
- Requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan (e.g. 9am-5pm EST/PST/CET)

KEEP only if one of these is true:
- Job says worldwide remote
- Job says work from anywhere
- Job says global remote
- Job says APAC remote
- Allows international contractors
- Accepts people based anywhere
- Company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement

Return ONLY valid JSON, no explanation before or after:
{
  "taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "reason": "short reason",
  "location_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"
}

Job post:
{{ $json.job_title }} at {{ $json.company }}
Location: {{ $json.location_text }}
Salary: {{ $json.salary }}

{{ $json.description.slice(0, 3000) }}"
    }
  ]
}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 600,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Background:
- Bilingual English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Digital marketing background with data science bootcamp experience
- Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics

Job Details:
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Why it fits: {{ $json.why_good_fit }}

Job Description (first 1500 chars):
{{ $json.description.slice(0, 1500) }}

Instructions:
- Make the letter specific to this job
- Mention how Jerry can reduce manual analysis time, improve reporting speed, connect marketing and data, build AI-assisted workflows, and turn messy data into business action
- Keep it under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- Do not start with 'I am writing to apply'
- Output only the cover letter text, no subject line or header"
    }
  ]
}

parameters.subject: =🇹🇼 Taiwan Remote Jobs – {{ $json.instant_apply > 0 ? $json.instant_apply + ' READY TO APPLY · ' : '' }}{{ $json.total_filtered }} Found Today
